applicabilityBasis.summary: Own eUSD is an overcollateralized on-chain CDP and peg stability module stablecoin on Robinhood Chain backed by smart-contract USDG, frxUSD, tokenized S&P 500 equity (eSPY), and WETH collateral, with no regulated fiat issuer obligated to redeem holders for fixed fiat monetary value under GENIUS Act Section 2(22). Redemptions settle on-chain in USDG or underlying collateral assets rather than bank-wired US dollars.

genius.notes: Own operates as an overcollateralized CDP, LP-vault, and PSM smart-contract protocol on Robinhood Chain without a licensed fiat issuer or fixed-money fiat redemption obligation. Protocol documentation publishes verified Robinhood Chain contract addresses, risk parameters, and redemption mechanics, and settles redemptions on-chain in USDG or collateral rather than regulated bank reserves or monthly CPA attestations.
